key_findings: Attention-blocking (L8-15) is net HARMFUL in aggregate (dSR_macro -5.15pp, Net -5): move_near -15.5pp (p=0.0035), pick_coke_can -6pp, only close_drawer +6pp.
Semantic-Merge (eta=1.0) is mildly negative in aggregate (dSR_macro -1.96pp, Net -2): move_near +4pp, close_drawer -4pp, pick_coke_can -6pp.
Merge >> Attention head-to-head overall (dSR_macro +3.67pp, Net +3.67), but the win is entirely move_near (+21pp, p=0.0002); close_drawer -10pp, pick_coke_can 0pp.
